description:
DAO Proposal Verdict: GO, CAUTION or BLOCK for one OpenZeppelin Governor proposal on Ethereum or Base, from decoded targets, Slither flags and a fork simulation diff.  Returns: a DAO proposal verdict on one OpenZeppelin Governor proposal: GO, CAUTION or BLOCK from decoded targets, governance reads, Slither flags on verified target contracts, and a fork simulation diff of outflows, mints and ownership changes. Unverified contracts are UNKNOWN, never assumed clean.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_q_verdict_v1/dao_proposal_verdict. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
name: x402_q_verdict_v1__dao_proposal_verdict
